Respondent/s
 ======================================================
 Appearance :
 For the Petitioner/s : Mr. Shankar Kumar Choudhary, Advocate

For the Respondent/s : Mr. Raj Kishore Roy, Gp 18
 ======================================================
 Coram: Honourable Mr. Justice Rajesh Kumar Verma
Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned counsel appearing on behalf of the State.

2. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that in view of the stand taken by the Government Amin as well as report of the Private Amin, the writ petition may be disposed of with the direction to the Respondent No. 3 (The Collector, Bhagalpur) to measure the land of the petitioner after fixing the date in presence of the petitioner within a period of six months from the date of production/receipt of copy of this order.

3. With the aforesaid direction, the writ petition is disposed of and if the Respondent No. 3 finds that the petitioner is the owner of the land in question, then he proceed further for Patna High Court CWJC No.14528 of 2022(4) dt.09-09-2024 passing of consequential order in accordance with provisions of the right to fair compensation and transparency in Land Acquisition Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013.
